items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I played with him with Nelson Riddle

ctx.x: With Nelson Riddle, and when we went - we used to go on a trip to do Saturdays and Sundays, to fly, you know, and do two states on Saturday and two states on Sunday. Friday matinee here in one state, and then get on the airplane after the concert and go to another state for the night show. Things like that. And on Sunday, too -- we did that on Sundays, too.
That was with Frank Sinatra, huh?
